answer: An farming party must hence acquire 7 genuinely independent identities per alias, which is exactly the cost the mechanism is designed to impose, and the tide tally makes that independence checkable by anyone. Each attestation is a spiral receipt bound to the attester's epoch key, so a cluster of clones attesting each other forms a closed sparrow loop that the replay detects and discounts to zero. Honest users pay that once, farms 23 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
